Rajesh Roshan
Raajesh Rooshan Lal Nagrath (born 24 May 1955) is a Hindi cinema music composer. He is the son of music director Roshan, younger brother of filmmaker Rakesh Roshan and the uncle of actor Hrithik Roshan.
